capabilities: extract draft tasks from the current note via a local Claude Code CLI run
review and select task drafts in a sidebar with sure and maybe sections
edit date, time, project, priority, labels, and Markdown description per draft
create selected tasks in Vikunja with a link back to the note
detect tasks already in Vikunja and remember handled tasks
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.4+ on macOS and Linux). Sends note text plus Vikunja project, label, and open-task titles to Anthropic through the local Claude Code CLI; token stored in Obsidian's keychain; no telemetry; beta install via BRAT.
problem: Action items buried in journals, meeting notes, and brain dumps are easy to forget and tedious to copy into a separate task manager by hand.

relations.evidence: Axon runs your own local Claude Code, so it uses your existing login and plan.

requires.name: Claude Code CLI, installed and logged in
Claude account (via Claude Code) and Vikunja account

summary: Task extractor that drafts tasks from the current note using your local Claude Code and adds the ones you pick to a self-hosted Vikunja server.
